{"code": "import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

df_dedup = df.loc[df.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].idxmax()]

# Exclude rows where biomarker_baseline is -999 (QC failure)
df_clean = df_dedup[df_dedup['biomarker_baseline'] != -999]

# Filter for treatment arm only
treatment_arm = df_clean[df_clean['arm'] == 'treatment']

# Compute fraction who responded
fraction_responded = treatment_arm['responded'].mean()

print(f"Number of patients in treatment arm: {len(treatment_arm)}")
print(f"Number of responders in treatment arm: {treatment_arm['responded'].sum()}")
print(f"Fraction responded: {fraction_responded}")"}
